description: Relic brings your reading life to ChatGPT. Search your private library for books, highlights, notes, saved words, and reading activity. Save new vocabulary and meanings directly to your Relic dictionary. Relic can read your library and write only to the dictionary; it cannot delete books, highlights, notes, or words. Requires an active Relic subscription or trial.

defaultPrompt: define serendipity and save it in my dictionary
i'm going through a breakup, remind me the most helpful highlights from the books i've read
what did i read last week and how can i apply it to my life?
